==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I became lucid from feeling my body move in the waking world. I became a space giant. I felt as if my body was actually growing.
I convinced a black hole to consume me. It took me to an alien world of pirates. I refused to join them and wiped out their planet.
I was captured by angels for destroying a planet. They told me they were as powerful as me. I effortlessly escaped Hail Veil, proving them wrong.
